caption: The drawing depicts a brown leather saddle with ornate floral tooling and designs adorning the seat and skirt areas. The saddle features detailed, raised patterns and is shown from a side angle, highlighting the curve of the seat, the horn at the top, and the stirrup hanging below. The saddle's floral designs appear to be deeply embossed, with multiple flower and leaf motifs visible on the fender and the skirt. The coloring consists mainly of shades of brown and tan, indicating leather, with subtle highlights and shadows giving it a three-dimensional appearance. The background of the drawing is a light, off-white color, with a few faint, irregular brown stains or marks scattered across the paper. The artist’s signature, “G. Fransen Jr.,” is located near the lower right corner of the image. There are no additional objects present in the drawing.
title: Saddle
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
